purpose: Define XiaoE billing, cost accounting, usage metering, budget controls and future commercial charging before any payment collection is enabled.

development_cost_policy.name: free_first_low_cost_second
development_cost_policy.default: Prefer free and lowest-cost viable solutions. Paid services are allowed only when clearly justified by stability, security, performance, compliance or real commercial need.
guardrails: Do not trade away security, data integrity, legal compliance or reliability merely to avoid cost.
Do not introduce paid infrastructure for prestige or architectural appearance alone.
Any recurring paid dependency should have a documented reason, expected value and exit or fallback path when practical.
Commercial charging capability does not justify unnecessarily high operating cost.

principles: Usage cost and customer charging are separate concepts and must be tracked separately.
No charge may be created from frontend UI alone.
All billable usage must be attributable to an authenticated identity, project and organization when applicable.
Provider cost must be recorded independently from XiaoE selling price.
Billing records must be auditable and must not depend on mutable client-side values.
Least privilege applies to viewing and changing billing configuration.
Paid provider calls remain subject to backend authorization and cost guardrails.
Free-first and low-cost development is the default operating strategy.

cost_accounting.rule: Raw provider cost must remain available even when customer-facing pricing uses a different formula.

commercial_charging.customer_price_rule: Customer pricing must be configuration-driven and must not be hardcoded into provider adapters.

integration_boundaries.ai_router: AI Router reports verified usage metadata to Billing/Cost Control after provider execution.
integration_boundaries.identity: Billing requires XiaoE identity and authorization before protected billing actions.
integration_boundaries.project_registry: Usage and cost must be attributable to project_key when project-specific.
integration_boundaries.payment_collection: A future payment provider may collect money, but payment credentials and webhooks must remain backend-side.

activation_gates: Only create commercial plans when a real commercial requirement exists.
Only connect a payment provider after billing records, permissions and webhook security are verified.
Verify test transactions in non-production mode before any real charge is enabled.
